props.name: before
props.description: Content shown on the left of the handle. Usually an image.

props.name: after
props.description: Content shown on the right of the handle. Usually an image.

props.name: value
props.description: Handle position from 0 to 100. Set it to control the component.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new position (0 to 100).

props.name: aspectRatio
props.description: Width to height ratio of the frame.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes added to the outer element.
